title: The Planets Gather for a Show in the Evening Sky (1/2)
titleZh: 行星齊聚，在傍晚的夜空中上演大秀 (1/2)
summaryZh: 二月底七大行星同時現身傍晚天空，形成罕見的行星連珠景象。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Science & Technology

sentences.text: All seven major planets form a kind of parade in the sky at the end of February.
sentences.zh: 二月底，七大行星會在天空中排成一列，像是在遊行一樣。

sentences.text: Although two of the planets are not visible to the unaided eye, all are on the same side of the sun during the evening hours.
sentences.zh: 雖然其中兩顆用肉眼看不到，但傍晚時分它們全都位在太陽的同一側。

sentences.text: This planetary grouping happens when the planets appear to line up in the night sky as seen from Earth.
sentences.zh: 當從地球看出去，這些行星在夜空中看起來排成一線時，就會出現這種行星聚集的現象。

sentences.text: They do not form a straight line, but they do stretch across the evening sky this year.
sentences.zh: 它們並不會排成一直線，但今年確實會橫跨整片傍晚的天空。

sentences.text: The American Space Agency, NASA, says these astronomical gatherings are common.
sentences.zh: 美國太空總署 NASA 表示，這類天文聚集現象其實很常見。

sentences.text: A parade of four or five planets visible to the unaided eye happens every few years.
sentences.zh: 肉眼可見的四、五顆行星連成一列，每隔幾年就會出現一次。

sentences.text: A similar parade took place last June, but only two planets could be seen without the use of special equipment.
sentences.zh: 去年六月也發生過類似的行星連珠，但不用特殊設備只看得到兩顆。

sentences.text: Six planets were visible in January.
sentences.zh: 一月的時候有六顆行星看得見。

sentences.text: Four were visible to the unaided eye.
sentences.zh: 其中四顆用肉眼就看得到。

sentences.text: In recent weeks, Mercury joined the group.
sentences.zh: 最近幾週，水星也加入了行列。

sentences.text: Venus, Mars, and Jupiter are all easily visible in the evening.
sentences.zh: 金星、火星和木星在傍晚都很容易看到。

sentences.text: Saturn is now very close to the setting sun, and Mercury is close to the horizon, making both hard to see.
sentences.zh: 土星現在很靠近落日，水星則接近地平線，兩顆都不好觀察。

sentences.text: Uranus and Neptune are the most distant planets.
sentences.zh: 天王星和海王星是距離最遠的行星。

sentences.text: Uranus can be glimpsed with binoculars or a telescope under good conditions.
sentences.zh: 條件好的時候，用雙筒望遠鏡或天文望遠鏡可以瞥見天王星。

sentences.text: But Neptune is now too close to the sun to be seen.
sentences.zh: 但海王星現在離太陽太近，看不到了。
